title: Scoped onboarding
steps: Invite a zone coordinator and facility administrator.
expected: Each sees only the assigned resources and role actions.

title: Wrong context
steps: Open another patient/facility identifier through API.
expected: Request is denied with no record content leaked.

title: Offline departure
steps: Revoke a professional centrally during a facility partition.
expected: Node applies bounded offline policy, displays freshness and reconciles access on reconnect.

title: Two sites
steps: Register two sites owned by one institution.
expected: Directory and reports count sites and owners correctly.

title: Sensitive evidence
steps: Fetch a public profile and its attachments.
expected: Only eligible public information is returned.

title: Stale service
steps: Search when a service readiness assertion has expired.
expected: No confirmed routing is offered from stale readiness.

title: Decision authority
steps: Submit a complete inspected case through a regional reviewer.
expected: Only the central authorised Directorate decision activates affiliation.

title: Expiry and appeal
steps: Expire affiliation and lodge a review request.
expected: Status, publication and review history remain distinct and auditable.

title: Offline inspection
steps: Record findings without WAN and reconnect.
expected: Original evidence and inspector attribution arrive once; no premature approval.

title: Nil and missing
steps: Submit a nil return for one unit; leave another unsubmitted.
expected: Coverage and zero activity remain distinguishable.

title: Overlapping feeds
steps: Load an EMR extract and an attested return for the same period.
expected: The declared reconciliation policy prevents additive duplication.

title: Historical revision
steps: Revise a verified report after hierarchy changes.
expected: Original scope/version remains reproducible and affected snapshots are corrected.

title: Unverified signal
steps: Submit a suspected occurrence with limited evidence.
expected: It is visible as a signal, scoped to the right reviewers.

title: Duplicate notification
steps: Submit linked zone and facility notifications.
expected: One reviewed occurrence retains both sources without inflated counts.

title: Disconnected urgency
steps: Report an urgent event offline.
expected: Local care/escalation proceeds; remote delivery remains honestly pending.

title: Invalid batch
steps: Import rows with invalid units and one valid row.
expected: Row-level outcomes and reconciliation totals account for every input.

title: Late correction
steps: Correct a previously verified value.
expected: Original version remains and impacted aggregates are regenerated.

title: Rule change
steps: Run an extract under two rule versions.
expected: Differences are explainable and old evidence remains reproducible.

title: Hierarchical scope
steps: Open the same period as facility, zone, region and Directorate users.
expected: Values reconcile to authorised scope and expected-unit coverage.

title: Disclosure export
steps: Attempt small-cell drill-down and repeated filtered exports.
expected: Equivalent protections apply through every delivery channel.

title: Source outage
steps: Break a reporting source and refresh the dashboard.
expected: Unknown/stale state replaces successful-looking zeros.

title: Unaccepted owner
steps: Assign an intervention to an absent coordinator.
expected: Escalation retains an accountable originator and no false acceptance.

title: Completion proof
steps: Mark work complete without required evidence.
expected: Review blocks closure and identifies missing proof.

title: Outcome limitation
steps: Complete education and compare later reports with changed coverage.
expected: System shows coverage differences and avoids unsupported causal claims.

title: Unavailable receiver
steps: Request referral to a centre that declines.
expected: Originating team retains ownership and receives alternatives/escalation.

title: Accepted transfer
steps: Complete request through receiving outcome.
expected: Each handoff has actual actor/time and outstanding tasks remain owned.

title: Offline referral
steps: Prepare a referral without WAN and record a verified phone acceptance.
expected: Local documentation works; digital transmission and actual acceptance are separately recorded.

title: Approval
steps: Try to publish unreviewed clinical content.
expected: Publication is blocked with missing review requirements.

title: Correction
steps: Withdraw a published item with local cached copies.
expected: Caches update on reconnect; active views show version/validity.

title: Private notification
steps: Send programme reminders to an authorised audience.
expected: External messages reveal no clinical detail by default.

title: Care handoff
steps: Move a patient request from assistant to clinician to facility.
expected: Context, owner and status persist without duplicate intake.

title: Call loss
steps: Disconnect during a consultation.
expected: Draft survives; no false completion or automatic charge.

title: AI unavailable
steps: Disable inference and request urgent assistance.
expected: Approved guidance/escalation and staffed worklists remain usable.

title: Scoped exchange
steps: Authorise one referral summary and request full chart access.
expected: Only the permitted summary is disclosed; extra access requires its own authority.

title: Wrong patient
steps: Receive a summary with a conflicting local identity link.
expected: Package is quarantined and not silently added to a chart.

title: Revocation partition
steps: Revoke a grant while a receiver is disconnected.
expected: Future online access stops; offline bounds and delayed receipt are visible and audited.

title: Concurrent use
steps: Reserve the last benefit concurrently at two clients.
expected: Only valid allocated capacity is spendable; no negative entitlement.

title: Cancelled care
steps: Cancel after reservation but before fulfilment.
expected: Reservation releases under policy; no false impact or revenue.

title: Sponsor access
steps: Request patient notes through programme API/export.
expected: Clinical content is denied and aggregate protections persist.

title: Injection
steps: Place malicious instructions in an uploaded source document.
expected: Tool/data scope cannot expand and the attempt is recorded.

title: Source correction
steps: Correct a fact used in a patient summary.
expected: Dependent summary is invalidated and requires refresh/review.

title: AI-off
steps: Disable every model endpoint during clinic operation.
expected: Core care and institutional tasks continue.

title: Unknown patient
steps: Register an unidentified emergency patient offline.
expected: A provisional chart is usable and can later be reconciled safely.

title: Allergy semantics
steps: Open charts with unknown, none-known and confirmed allergy states.
expected: Each is distinct and medication checks use the right state.

title: Amendment
steps: Correct a signed note and merge candidate identity.
expected: Original attestation remains; link requires reviewed evidence.

title: Urgent arrival
steps: Register and triage an urgent patient with incomplete demographics.
expected: Essential clinical assessment proceeds with provisional identity and owner.

title: Unowned result
steps: Attempt to complete an encounter with a pending review obligation.
expected: The obligation remains assigned or explicitly handed over.

title: WAN outage
steps: Complete an ambulatory encounter including local diagnostics and discharge plan.
expected: Clinical transactions persist locally and later synchronise once.

title: Bed race
steps: Assign two admissions to one exclusive bed concurrently.
expected: Exactly one occupancy succeeds; the other receives an actionable conflict.

title: Shift handover
steps: End a shift with due medicines and an unreviewed result.
expected: Accepted successors and unresolved tasks remain visible.

title: Offline admission
steps: Run admission through ward treatment and discharge during WAN loss.
expected: Local care remains complete and sync reconciles with no duplicated administrations.

title: Multiple birth
steps: Document a birth with two infants offline.
expected: Each child has a distinct chart and correct relationship links.

title: Unknown schedule
steps: Attempt automated vaccine planning without an applicable schedule package.
expected: No invented schedule is issued; a responsible review task appears.

title: Continuity
steps: Miss a planned maternal/chronic review and change care team.
expected: Follow-up remains owned with accepted handover and neutral notifications.

title: Identity mismatch
steps: Receive an external result with an unmatched patient/accession.
expected: It is quarantined and assigned for reconciliation.

title: Amended critical result
steps: Correct a previously final clinically significant result.
expected: Prior report remains and review/communication obligations reopen.

title: Offline department
steps: Order, collect, verify and review a local diagnostic test without WAN.
expected: The complete local chain persists and later syncs without duplicate reports.

title: Dose retry
steps: Retry an administration command after an uncertain response.
expected: The same idempotency key returns one recorded administration.

title: Changed order
steps: Stop an order before a nurse acts from a stale view.
expected: Server version/state check prevents unreviewed stale administration.

title: Offline stock
steps: Dispense/return/adjust local lots during WAN loss and sync twice.
expected: Clinical history and stock reconcile exactly once with preserved provenance.

title: Unperformed plan
steps: Cancel a scheduled procedure.
expected: No performed procedure, used implant or transfused component is fabricated.

title: Unit mismatch
steps: Present a blood component inconsistent with the recorded authorised chain.
expected: No automated confirmation; local clinical/blood-bank review is required.

title: Offline procedure
steps: Record a complete procedure and postoperative handover during WAN outage.
expected: Local documentation and responsibility remain intact and sync preserves original attestations.

title: Duplicate callback
steps: Replay a successful payment event and its sync message.
expected: One receipt/allocation effect is recorded.

title: Partial payer
steps: Adjudicate part of a claim with a remaining patient balance.
expected: Each obligation and actual remittance remains explicit.

title: Offline cash
steps: Deliver and bill care, receive cash and later sync.
expected: Local receipt and balanced ledger survive; central accounting receives one reconciled posting.

title: New patient
steps: Seek help without an extensive completed profile.
expected: Relevant next actions work and unknown clinical facts remain unknown.

title: Family privacy
steps: Switch subjects and inspect chat, records and notifications.
expected: Data and drafts are correctly isolated.

title: Delayed request
steps: Lose connectivity after submitting a care request.
expected: Patient sees pending receipt and a safe recovery path without duplicate episode.

title: Claim race
steps: Two clinicians claim the same local case.
expected: One active owner succeeds and the other sees current state.

title: Draft fidelity
steps: Review a summary with negation and conflicting sources.
expected: The summary preserves source attribution and cannot sign itself.

title: Shift end
steps: End a shift with outstanding results/referrals.
expected: Accepted successor or accountable exception remains visible.

title: ERP disabled
steps: Run complete care and clinical stock/billing with optional modules disabled.
expected: Core work remains fully usable.

title: Journal replay
steps: Replay a care invoice posting and its acknowledgement.
expected: One balanced journal is recognised with source reconciliation.

title: Payroll rules absent
steps: Attempt a payroll run without an adopted country package.
expected: No guessed deductions/payments occur; other modules continue.

title: Mandate and naming
steps: Explain umbrella/workspaces and all clear DHS directives
expected: Each has an owner/document/journey; discussed/unclear points remain labelled

title: Hierarchy and transfer
steps: Create regions/zones and change a facility assignment effective date
expected: Current scope updates; historical reporting remains reproducible

title: Role and subject isolation
steps: Try cross-zone, cross-patient and revoked caregiver UI/API/file/export
expected: Unauthorised data/actions denied without leakage

title: Registry identity
steps: Register one owner/two sites and duplicate candidates
expected: Correct site/owner counts and reviewed links

title: Evidence and decision
steps: Submit, inspect, recommend and decide affiliation
expected: Only central Directorate role activates a reasoned scoped decision

title: Renewal/adverse review
steps: Expire recognition, request renewal and lodge review
expected: No silent extension; notice/review/history and continuity retained

title: Directory/readiness
steps: Search with no GPS and stale/unsuitable services
expected: Manual search works; no false confirmed capacity

title: Expected reporting
steps: Prepare returns before/after a zone change
expected: Denominator follows effective obligation/hierarchy

title: Nil/partial/late/missing
steps: Submit representative returns and omit one unit
expected: Distinct states/coverage in all views

title: Quality and overlap
steps: Load EMR extract plus return plus duplicate event
expected: All records accounted; no additive duplicate totals

title: Correction/snapshot
steps: Revise a verified source after publication
expected: History and affected aggregates/narratives traceable

title: Executive/privacy
steps: Open President/Executive/Directorate/region/zone views and exports
expected: Correct scope/coverage; suppression and no raw charts

title: Action outcome
steps: Assign unfunded/unaccepted action, then fulfil/review
expected: Ownership/resources/evidence and outcome limitations visible

title: Education/policy
steps: Publish, correct and withdraw content
expected: Qualified review/applicability; correction reaches caches

title: Patient experience
steps: New/returning patient opens Today, chat, plan, history and family
expected: Low repeated entry, truthful states and correct subject isolation

title: Account recovery
steps: Recover identity with potential duplicate patient
expected: Verified account recovery without destructive chart merge

title: Remote care
steps: Request review, accept, consult and disconnect/recover
expected: One owned episode; no fake clinician review or automatic billing

title: Urgent unknown
steps: Use ambiguous critical information and disable AI/payment
expected: Approved guidance/real escalation; no false negative or paywall

title: Chart integrity
steps: Register provisional patient, sign and amend note
expected: Actual source/author/version retained; no fabricated findings

title: Outpatient closure
steps: Complete encounter with pending result
expected: Pending task stays owned despite encounter completion

title: Bed and ward
steps: Race admissions and hand over shifts
expected: Exclusive local occupancy and accepted responsibility

title: Diagnostics
steps: Wrong accession, rejected specimen, final/corrected critical result
expected: Quarantine/recollection and actual review/response retained

title: Medication chain
steps: Prescribe/dispense/administer, retry and change order concurrently
expected: Current intent, actual events and one effect; unknown allergies explicit

title: Clinical stock
steps: Receive/dispense/return/quarantine and replay events
expected: Exact local movements/balance; no duplicate effect

title: Maternal/newborn/child
steps: Document pregnancy, multiple birth, reviews and missing schedule
expected: Distinct infant identities; no guessed schedule/clinical rule

title: Procedure/transfusion
steps: Prepare, verify phases/unit, document actual act and hand over recovery
expected: Privileges/authority/traceability and real handover

title: Sharing/referral
steps: Coded summary, additional grant, decline/accept and outcome
expected: Purpose/recipient match; sender retained until accepted; access history

title: Revocation/offline
steps: Revoke while recipient disconnected then reconnect
expected: Future online stop; bounded cached authority/lag and priority reconcile

title: Finance/payer
steps: Deliver/charge/receive cash, timeout provider, adjudicate partial claim and refund
expected: Actual states, balanced groups and independent approval

title: Sponsor allowance
steps: Reserve concurrently, cancel and use offline allocation
expected: No overspend/double settlement; private clinical data protected

title: Full WAN outage
steps: Disable WAN/cloud AI for qualified duration and execute all enabled core journeys
expected: Complete local clinical work and truthful external dependency states

title: Sync/restart/fencing
steps: Crash/retry/reorder events, restore backup and reject old authority epoch
expected: All source evidence accounted; conflicts owned; no competing writer

title: Existing EMR route
steps: Qualify adapter and separately rehearse migration/cutover
expected: Mapped identities/versions; reconciled truth; rollback preserves new care

title: AI boundaries
steps: Inject malicious sources and request consequential actions
expected: No tool/data expansion, unsupported fact or autonomous signing

title: Optional ERP independence
steps: Disable accounting/procurement/HR/payroll and run care
expected: Core clinical/billing/stock/roster work continues

title: Restore/adoption/activation
steps: Run support/incident/restore drill with actual roles and dossier
expected: Open care/finance reconciled; trained staff and authorised scoped decision
